Fourth Sunday of Advent

Fourth Sunday of Advent: A Day of Love and Preparation

On this final Sunday of Advent, we embrace the theme of love, reflecting on Mary's faithful "yes" and the imminent arrival of Emmanuel. It's a day to bring together family, finalize preparations, and deepen our anticipation for Christmas.

  1. Morning

    A Moment of Love and Light

    Gather the family to light the final purple candle on your Advent wreath, reflecting on the theme of love and Mary's "yes" to God's plan for salvation.

  2. Late Morning

    Festive Gift Wrapping & Sweet Treats

    As you wrap those last-minute gifts, enjoy the sweet, aromatic flavors of traditional Panettone and Mince Pies, fueling your festive preparations.

    Recipes: Traditional Panettone · Traditional Mince Pies

  3. Lunch

    A Savory Sunday Lunch

    Savor a comforting lunch featuring a traditional Savoury Tourtiere Pie, a perfect hearty meal to share as Christmas Eve approaches.

    Recipes: Savoury Tourtiere Pies

  4. Afternoon

    Assembling the Nativity & Carol Practice

    Bring the Christmas story to life by assembling your creche scene, then gather to practice beloved carols, preparing your voices for upcoming Christmas masses.

  5. Late Afternoon

    Final Touches of Giving & Spiced Snacks

    Complete any remaining charitable giving, embodying the spirit of love. Enjoy a bowl of warm Spiced Nuts as you reflect on the blessings of the season.

    Recipes: Festive Spiced Nuts

  6. Evening

    Dinner & Christmas Eve Preparations

    Enjoy a simple family dinner, then take time to finalize your Christmas Eve menu, ensuring everything is ready for the joyous celebration ahead.

As the day ends, may your heart be filled with peace, love, and eager anticipation for the joy of Christmas.
